top_signals.title: Qualcomm rival MediaTek jumps 10% after $3.5 billion Nvidia AI chip deal
top_signals.summary: The two companies will work on integrating Nvidia technology with MediaTek's custom AI chip business as well as other areas such as PCs and cars.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
